linkedin.text:
I just found a repo that solves a problem I didn't realize was killing my product workflow.

Every time I asked Claude to help with product thinking, I got walls of text. Generic advice. No structure. I'd end up copy-pasting frameworks from Notion docs just to force some rigor into the output.

Then I installed PM Skills Marketplace (21K stars on GitHub).

Now when I type /discover, Claude walks me through the Opportunity Solution Tree — ideation, assumption mapping, prioritization, experiment design — step by step. When I type /strategy, I get a complete Product Strategy Canvas. When I type /write-prd, I get an actual PRD with the structure of a top PM, not a doc template filled with fluff.

It's 68 PM skills and 42 workflows plugged directly into Claude Code and Cowork. Every command chains proven frameworks from Teresa Torres, Marty Cagan, Alberto Savoia.

The install takes 2 minutes. The result is product decisions with actual rigor behind them.

If you're a PM using AI assistants and you're tired of generic responses, this repo changes everything. Link in comments.
